# Memory Math Match

Memory Math Match is a free, web-based educational game combining memory matching with math challenges.

## Routes
- `/`: Main game lobby and settings selection.
- `/play`: Play page (supports `mode=practice` and `mode=time`).
- `/levels`: Map view with 1000+ levels for quest progression.
- `/daily-challenge`: Specialized daily matching challenge.
- `/blog`: Blog listing page for math, memory, early childhood, and classroom configurations.
- `/about`: About the game.
- `/faq`: Frequently asked questions.
- `/how-to-play`: Instructions on gameplay.
- `/privacy-policy`: Privacy policy page.
- `/terms`: Terms of service page.
- `/contact`: Contact details.

## Informational pages:
- `/benefits-of-memory-games`
- `/benefits-of-mental-math`
- `/daily-brain-training`
- `/improve-concentration`
